title: Violence erupts in KP as federal government moves toward imposing emergency rule
detail: Violence has erupted in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as the Pakistani government moves toward imposing emergency rule in the PTI stronghold province. Protests and clashes have intensified amid the political and security standoff between federal authorities and the PTI-led provincial government.

media.caption: Violence erupts in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as emergency rule looms
